{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Mining Laser''' is the primary hardpoint for [[Laser Mining|laser mining]]. It breaks ordinary fragments from suitable asteroids; those fragments still have to be collected and processed by a [[Refinery]] before they become cargo.

{{Draft warning}}

== Mining role ==

{{#invoke:Mining|equipmentNote|page=Mining Laser}}

Mining lasers are not used for every mining method. [[Core Mining]] uses seismic charges and abrasion blasting, while [[Sub-surface Mining]] uses displacement missiles. A commander fitting for laser mining should reserve enough optional space for collector support, a refinery, cargo, and limpets rather than filling only hardpoints.
